#   IANA Addresses › Reserved Networks
#   
#   This list contains reserved and special-purpose IPv4 address ranges
#   designated by the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) for
#   non-public routing and protocol-specific network functions.
#   
#   The ranges included within this dataset primarily cover:
#      - 224.0.0.0/4     (IPv4 multicast space)
#      - 240.0.0.0/4     (Reserved / future-use space)
#      - 255.255.255.255 (Limited broadcast address)
#   
#   These address ranges are not intended for standard public internet
#   host communication and are typically reserved for multicast traffic,
#   broadcast behavior, protocol functions, or future allocation use.
#   
#   Traffic originating from or targeting these ranges on public-facing
#   infrastructure may indicate spoofed packets, malformed traffic,
#   amplification attempts, scanning activity, or network abuse.
#   
#   Many routers, firewalls, and operating systems treat these ranges
#   as non-routable or restricted under standard networking behavior.
#   
#   This list is sourced from officially assigned IANA special-purpose
#   address registries and updated periodically as standards evolve.
